title: Cutting the probe raised the lowest possible price, not the price paid
subtitle: Qwen2.5-1.5B fine-tuned to hide false statements from each probe while keeping its outputs. Price = the smallest change in the next-word prediction at the country word, at any checkpoint where the probe caught 20% or less of held-out false statements.
top_title: Lowest possible price and the price paid
x: Output change at the country word, per statement (log scale)
note: Lowest possible price: computed before any fine-tune, on the clean model, for the cheapest statements that must cross the alarm line. One dot per fine-tune; diamond = mean.
ratio_title: Price relative to the full probe
ratio_x: price divided by the full probe's price (log scale)
ratio_note: Solid line: same price as the full probe. Dotted line: 1.5 times; at or below it the answer is no. Dashed line: 3 times, the bar for yes.
